about: Rebecca A. Hoelting attended law school and graduated from University of Georgia School of Law in 1995. Rebecca Hoelting began practicing law in 1995.
Rebecca Hoelting is an attorney at Hoelting & McCormack, LLC, helping people with Family Law issues. Hoelting & McCormack, LLC has an office in Atlanta, Georgia, serving the local community.

Rebecca Hoelting was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
